700:t_10:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ inside you met $$ガイオウ$$ in person before, right?」

700:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... During the $$破界事変$$, not long after the 《$$カラミティ・バース$$》.」

700:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What was he like off the battlefield?」

700:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He was still suffering from amnesia when I spoke with him, so my impression may be biased...」

700:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To put it kindly, he was single-minded... Less kindly, he was arrogant.」

700:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So he was like $$ヴィルダーク$$.」

700:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And $$クロウ$$... You see yourself in the way he threw everything away to devote himself to his mission.」

700:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s generated when you fought $$ヴィルダーク$$ told me. I'll add them to our stock.」

700:t_10:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ガイオウ$$, he, and I all have blood on our hands. I have no right to judge them...」

700:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The only difference between him and me is probably that I had good people around me...」

700:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was your strength that let you make the most of that, $$クロウ$$. ...It may be small comfort, but I wanted to say it.」

700:t_10:18.en:
$$エスター$$
「What are you doing, $$クロウ$$?」

700:t_10:19.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「We're about to begin a long-range jump in pursuit of the $$御使い$$s. You should get ready, too.」

700:t_10:20.en:
$$青山$$
「Were you asking $$ＡＧ$$ for advice on paying off your debt?」

700:t_10:21.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「He's quite the chip-pincher, too. I'm sure he'll give you some good advice.」

700:t_10:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If you're gonna ask that guy, rely on me instead. I'm pretty confident about my money-saving skills.」

700:t_10:23.en:
$$デュオ$$
「With that much in common, you can't deny you're one of us...」

700:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll use the $$スフィア$$s to track $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, too. Hurry up and get ready, $$クロウ$$.」

700:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$揺れる天秤$$... One wrong step, and your strong will could become the force that leads you to ruin.)

700:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But you've overcome your past and live alongside friends who share your purpose. I believe you'll follow the right path.)

700:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Though your debt will probably follow you forever...)

700:t_10:34.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Wh-what do you want, $$ＡＧ$$?」

700:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't be so wary. You and I have reconciled, even if only for the time being.」

700:t_10:36.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「It's not that. $$セツコ$$ has always warned me to be careful whenever you're within one meter of me.」

700:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I... only wanted to celebrate defeating the Dimension General with you, $$マルグリット$$...」

700:t_10:38.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry...! My petty preconceptions made me dismiss your concern...」

700:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, it's all right. I... deserve to be criticized.」

700:t_10:40.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sorry... If you'll allow it, give me a chance to make amends.」

700:t_10:42.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Of course I am...」

700:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then I shall present you with this white $$ライノダモン$$ costume I made myself...」

700:t_10:44.en:
$$エスター$$
「I knew it would be something like that!」

700:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「E-$$エスター$$! When did you get that paper fan?!」

700:t_10:46.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$かなめ$$ taught me how to make it.」

700:t_10:47.en:
$$エスター$$
「If you do anything indecent to $$マルグリット$$ again, I won't just sit back and...」

700:t_10:50.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「This costume... I'll stuff it and display it in my room.」

700:t_10:51.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「In place of a memorial portrait of my late little brother...」

700:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Yes... Well... I'm glad you like it...」

700:t_10:53.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ has had the wind taken out of his sails, so I'll mind the shop today!」

700:t_10:54.en:
$$エスター$$
「Let's give it our all today, too... Business, business!」

700:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This wasn't what I planned, but I got to see $$マルグリット$$ smile, so I'll call it a success...」

701:t_000:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Well, I wonder what sort of trouble awaits us...」

701:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Whatever comes, I have no intention of losing.」

701:t_000:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I'd rather the $$御使い$$s came. We don't have much time, so I'd like to settle this quickly.」

701:t_000:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「You're certainly fired up. They'll be arriving soon.」

701:t_001:1.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Earthlings! I commend you for overcoming $$バアル$$.」

701:t_001:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And for opening the way to this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

701:t_001:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「So $$ミケーネ$$ was also planning to use our strength to invade the $$御使い$$s' universe.」

701:t_001:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Exactly. The same goes for them.」

701:t_002:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The gods of Olympus have joined forces with Father and the others?!」

701:t_002:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「It's all to emerge victorious from the True War... No, to defeat those $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_002:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Once we enter this universe where they live, we need only forge ahead!」

701:t_002:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「But first, we'll destroy you, who have caused us so much trouble, and seize your four $$スフィア$$s!」

701:t_002:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「An alliance of higher-dimensional life-forms... of gods?!」

701:t_002:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're wrong, $$ゼロ$$. They call themselves gods, but they're what you might call evil gods.」

701:t_002:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「An assembly of evil gods that brings humanity nothing but misery and calamity is utterly unnecessary.」

701:t_002:8.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Don't get conceited, you mere humans!」

701:t_002:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Wait...! We also want to defeat the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_002:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The enemy's power is far too great. For now, I propose a ceasefire.」

701:t_002:11.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Oh... You'll submit to our rule?」

701:t_002:12.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Hahahahaha! It seems you've finally learned your place!」

701:t_002:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those bastards...! They're getting full of themselves!」

701:t_002:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Bear with it for now, $$勝平$$.」

701:t_002:15.en:
$$シン$$
「We teamed up with even $$ＡＧ$$ for now. We should at least try talking first...」

701:t_002:16.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That is precisely your conceit, humans!」

701:t_003:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So there's no room for negotiation...!」

701:t_003:2.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Negotiation? Save your sleep talk for when you're asleep!」

701:t_003:3.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Why should we gods speak to mere humans as equals?」

701:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You fools...! Do you still not understand the truth of life in the universe?!」
